def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    x = inputs.get('X', inputs.get('x', inputs.get('start', inputs.get('initial'))))
    rounds = inputs.get('rounds', inputs.get('steps', inputs.get('n')))
    a = inputs.get('a', inputs.get('multiplier'))
    c = inputs.get('c', inputs.get('increment', inputs.get('addend')))
    m = inputs.get('m', inputs.get('mod', inputs.get('modulus')))
    for _ in range(rounds):
        x = (a * x + c) % m
    return x

{"code":"def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    M = inputs.get('M', inputs.get('matrix'))
    n = inputs.get('power', inputs.get('exponent', inputs.get('n')))
    mod = inputs.get('mod', inputs.get('modulus'))
    if M is None:
        M = [[inputs['a'], inputs['b']], [inputs['c'], inputs['d']]]
    def mul(A, B):
        return [[sum(A[i][k] * B[k][j] for k in range(len(B))) % mod
                 for j in range(len(B[0]))] for i in range(len(A))]
    size = len(M)
    R = [[int(i == j) for j in range(size)] for i in range(size)]
    B = [[x % mod for x in row] for row in M]
    while n:
        if n & 1:
            R = mul(R, B)
        B = mul(B, B)
        n //= 2
    return sum(map(sum, R))"}
